steps.content: [Play voice acting first before showing portrait]

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Well, well, if it isn't our persistent young lord again! How many visits has it been now? Such a delightfully stubborn soul...
steps.female_content: Well, well, if it isn't our persistent young lady again! How many visits has it been now? Such a delightfully stubborn soul...

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: But lovestruck fools like you are a common sight around here. If we let you in today and someone else tomorrow, the Wisteria Pavilion's threshold would be worn to dust.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Off you go now, off you go! This is no place for ordinary folk, and our precious Yingying isn't someone just anyone can meet.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The ladies approach with melodious laughter, moving forth to usher you out once more. Yet, a shift in the air is palpable—upon closer reflection, a revelation begins to dawn on you. Might it be that the flower spirits deem you... mundane, lacking the brilliance to captivate their gaze?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Perhaps a treasure lies in your possession that might turn the tide?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Present [Jade Blossom Robe]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The Jade Blossom Robe it is.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The outlander draws forth the Jade Blossom Robe, and suddenly, it erupts in shimmering radiance, draping around him like spring vines. In the blink of an eye, the once-ordinary outlander transforms into a figure of sublime grace and elegance!
steps.female_content: The outlander draws forth the Jade Blossom Robe, and suddenly, it erupts in shimmering radiance, draping around her like spring vines. In the blink of an eye, the once-ordinary outlander transforms into a figure of sublime grace and elegance!

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh my.

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh my.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: My, my. No wonder they all say clothes make the person! Just one change of outfit and you're a whole new being. Just look at that lovely face!

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: ...Someone with such a lovely face couldn't possibly be a bad egg, right?

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Ahem! A pleasing appearance is all well and good, but youth fades like a summer breeze. How often has surface judgment led to lasting happiness? What our precious Yingying seeks is a lifelong commitment.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh... right, right! A pretty face alone won't get you far in life!

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Young lord, if this is all you have to offer, we cannot bear to see Yingying suffer any hardship. It's best for you to leave.
steps.female_content: Young lady, if this is all you have to offer, we cannot bear to see Yingying suffer any hardship. It's best for you to leave.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Just as things begin to look up, fate deals another cruel hand. 　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 The ladies exchange meaningful glances, their demeanor frosty again towards you. It seems they seek not just a gilded exterior, but the weight of true worth within.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Now then, might your possession contain—

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Save your reminder.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Present [Wealth-Attracting Gem]

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh my, what's this? Such a magnificent gem—please, keep it away! The brilliance is nearly blinding me!

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: My, my! What a pretty little gem indeed! I'm not quite versed in such things, but... is it something particularly special?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'd say it's worth enough to buy out the entire street outside the Wisteria Pavilion.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Is that so? C-could this be... the legendary heirloom of some noble lord? Like straight out of a love story? Are we actually living one of those stories right now?

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Ahem! Let's not get carried away, sis. Who's to say if this gem is even genuine?

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Even if it is so, that hardly proves anything. For all we know, you might lose your senses one day and gamble away everything at Gold Toad's place.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh yes, yes, exactly! We've seen plenty of people flashing treasures while not even having a steady job to their name. Why should we make an exception for you?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Faced with the relentless scrutiny and questioning from them, the outlander grows flustered, unable to defend against their accusations.　　　　　　　　　　 Left with no choice, the outlander reaches into the pouch once more, deciding to let the evidence speak for itself.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Hand over the bank card

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: This is my monthly payroll card, with my position details on the back. My hours may vary, but I do have stable incomes. Plus, I don't have any costly vices.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh, a civil servant! Well... that's not bad at all. Though the workplace might be a bit far, in these rough times, a stable job is reliable. It would keep Yingying well provided for.

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Not bad at all? How could that be reliable? These material comforts are just for show—without a heart truly dedicated to her, they mean nothing at all.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Exactly! Having good looks and a comfortable living doesn't mean you'll treat our Yingying well, does it?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Gold may be easily acquired, yet a genuine heart is a rare gem.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 In but a few exchanges, the ladies reveal their third trial—to thoroughly test the sincerity of this outlander's heart.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Now, that secret tome might just prove useful.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Surely you have memorized all those romantic verses and love poems for wooing fair maidens by now?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Recite romantic verses from [Chronicles of Romance and Lust]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: In the depths unknown, l-love springs, binding my heart and soul, sweetly melting...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: A day without your sight, y-yearning grows. Becomes enchantment, thoughts of you bestows...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: To know your heart, love fills our way. Our tale unending, forever we'll stay...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: After that painfully delivered recitation, a heavy silence descends upon the gathering, thickening the air with an almost palpable weight.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: As the expressions of the ladies shift subtly, the outlander realizes that the clever plan has spectacularly backfired.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Holding all three mystical artifacts, triumph should have been certain. How did it come to this woeful state? Alas, alas...

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Your first time doing something like this, darling? Is this your first taste of love? Look at you, all red-faced and sweating... Take a breath before you faint from holding it in.

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Where did you pick up all these cheesy lines? Oh, so easily fooled... just as innocent as you look. These clothes and that gem... you must have saved up for quite a while to make it here, right?

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: You've gone to such lengths just to meet her?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I want to see her. Full of heart.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The ghostly guardians at the threshold fix their gaze upon the outlander, and after a long moment, finally let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Alright, alright... I'll stop giving you a hard time. Naive you may be, but sincerity is what truly matters.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: That's right—whether you can stay together ultimately depends on Yingying's feelings. You mustn't pressure our precious girl.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Come now, let's give the young ones some time to themselves. It's time for us to step back.

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Let's go, shall we... This is their moment now...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The ladies' laughter fades like the morning mist, vanishing with a passing breeze.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 You are now left alone in the courtyard, accompanied only by the wisteria tree at its heart.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The fragrance of flowers brushes your face as the swaying blossoms reveal a figure in their shadows—none other than the "flower fairy" who has captured the outlander's heart.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: There she rests against the wisteria vine in the cool night air, draped only in wisps of gossamer. She sleeps peacefully amid the fragrant blossoms, undisturbed by your earlier intrusion or the clamoring crowds beyond the courtyard walls.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Just as you take a step forward, her eyelashes flutter softly, and her eyes open in a dreamy haze, meeting yours in that moment.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...I was just dreaming of you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I had this dream where my moms were driving you away again—they are always so protective of me. I was just about to help you when... poof! The dream ended.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come closer now. Why are you standing so far away today? I can barely see you...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: She rises languidly to stretch with gentle grace and rubs her eyes. Her gaze falls upon you, the remnants of drowsiness still lingering. After a long moment, she suddenly blushes, averting her eyes bashfully.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Where did you get this new robe? What happened to your gray one...?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Her voice emerges soft, tinged with unexpected shyness—could it be the effect of the [Jade Blossom Robe]?　　　　　　　　　　 Seeing her cheeks flush pink beneath the dancing flower shadows, something stirs in your heart, compelling you to respond—

steps.speaker: Option
options: I wanted to look proper visiting you.
Do you like it?
Nah, someone just gave it to me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Our first meeting was quite unexpected. This time, I wanted to pay you a proper visit.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I wanted to make a good impression on you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hehe, such an earnest young lord you are... Are you even more nervous than I am?
steps.female_content: Hehe, such an earnest young lady you are... Are you even more nervous than I am?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't worry, you've already left quite an impression on me.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: She offers a gentle smile, lifting her gaze to meet yours with tender affection and praise in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: Do you like it?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I do. You look great in white. No wonder my moms took such a liking to you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: With such charm, you must captivate hearts wherever you go.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: As her words trail off, a deeper blush colors her cheeks. Realizing she may have spoken too boldly, she raises her hands to hide her face, falling into a shy silence.

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: Oh, someone happened to give it to me.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: ...How utterly oblivious to the ways of romance.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh... a gift from another, I see. It has a delightful scent—perhaps from some maiden's secret admiration. And you decided to wear it for our meeting...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: That's rather inappropriate, isn't it...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Though a hint of jealousy colors her words, she appears not upset, and her gaze even holds a touch of playful reproach—clearly, your unintentional disregard has only fanned the flames of her interest.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: It appears that the Jade Blossom Robe has indeed worked its magic, and now the outlander's thoughts turn to the other two treasures in possession. Capturing a maiden's heart requires both patience and finesse—what shall be your next move?

options: Stop making fun of me—I'm here on official business.
Present the [Wealth-Attracting Gem]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Heh... What a hopeless dullard.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Is that...?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Suddenly, something slips from the outlander's sleeve, on the verge of tumbling to the ground. With swift elegance, Yingying summons a tendril to intercept its descent that delicately places it into her hands.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: —Lo and behold, the Wealth-Attracting Gem has awakened its magic, as though guided by a spirit intent on weaving the threads of destiny.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: What a beautiful gem, sparkling like a star. Is this... a gift for me?

options: Yes, sorry for disturbing you.
Yes, because it reminds me of you.
Give it back. It belongs to someone else.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I wasn't sure what gifts are appreciated in Eastia, so I asked around and brought the most precious thing I could find.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Oh dear, you don't seem to come from wealth. Your fine clothes must have cost you quite a fortune too. Please, you needn't go to such lengths—take it back.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: We're not the kind to care about material wealth. Just come visit whenever you wish—I'll convince my moms to allow it, alright?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: A blissful moment thus unfolds, as tender glances convey volumes of unspoken affection. Even the renowned Chronicles of Romance and Lust could paint no finer scene.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: All the passionate verses from the tome of romance flash through the outlander's mind, each line tailored perfectly to this fated encounter. In this intimate courtyard where no others intrude, only one step remains to win the fair maiden's heart—

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: Yes, because it reminds me of you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It reminds me of you—how its radiance shines even in the darkest night, much like your eyes. That's why I used up everything I had to get it, for you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Well... I...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Such honeyed words ignite a deeper blush upon the flower spirit's cheeks, her lips parting yet no words finding their way out.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Heh, behold our outlander's charm—even without the aid of mystical artifacts, you could effortlessly kindle flames in one's heart. Why not seize the moment and secure the deal with the third treasure?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: You must have already memorized every affectionate verse from the Chronicles of Romance and Lust.

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: Give it back. It belongs to someone else.
[Empty Scene] 2 seconds, with optional awkward ambient sounds like crow caws, cricket chirps, or whistling wind

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: A chilling wind sweeps through, freezing the maiden's smile and dispersing the sweetness in the air.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Awkwardly, she places the precious gem back in your palm, her face flushing as she searches desperately for any excuse to slip away.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In truth, even the most enchanting treasures cannot coax a flower from such a hopeless stone.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Here's your treasure back. Look at you being so careful—"It belongs to someone else."... This "someone else" must hold quite a special place in your heart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Heh... True love is indeed precious in this world. I guess I was just... intruding.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Her expression dims as her form begins to fade, threatening to dissolve into the wisteria blossoms. Should she truly depart now, you may never find her again.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: *Sigh* But do remember your purpose here. If you cannot win the flower spirit's heart, how will those trapped in this eerie fete ever escape? The tales speak of the Chief holding all of DisCity dear—surely you can muster a touch of charm?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: This is your final opportunity. You still possess one last treasure—those affectionate verses from Chronicles of Romance and Lust that you know by heart—

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: <size=24>This really is endless...</size>

options: "I'm sorry, I'm just so nervous."
Stop wasting time and be honest

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Nervous? Why? Are you afraid of me?

options: "I just wanted to see you so bad."
Stop wasting time and be honest

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Wanted to see me...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh! You mean...

options: "Yes, I fell for you at first sight..."
Stop wasting time and be honest

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Wait, wait, hold on... I'm not ready for this...

options: "I feel the same way..."
Stop wasting time and be honest

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not sure what's happening to me, but I can't stop thinking about you. Whether I'm strolling down the street or catching the scent of flowers—in my everyday world that shouldn't involve you, I keep running into hints of you everywhere.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: When did you slip into my life? When did these feelings begin? It's all so strange... I even started to think you must have cast some spell on me when I wasn't looking.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But no matter how hard I try, I can't find any evidence of your mischief. And before I know it, I find myself sitting by the street again, lost in thoughts of you for the longest time.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: How can you just pour your heart out like that? At least give me a moment to catch my breath... You're making my head spin...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: No one has ever said such things to me before... Do you mean that you... adore me?

options: "Yes, I want to spend the rest of my life with you."
"Yes, I want to share my life with you."

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: From this moment on, from dawn till dusk, I don't want to live in memories and longing anymore. I want to see you every day.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let me come closer, let me know you better, and let me share my life with you. Come with me, Yingying.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...How strange. We've only met twice, and you're not even from around here... yet somehow, this makes me so happy.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I find myself wanting to spend more time with you too...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If I come with you, will you take good care of me?

options: "Of course."

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Will you pledge your heart to me forever, never to betray me?

options: "Never to betray you."

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Mmm... uh huh... how about you swear it to heaven?
[Music stops, sound of wind]

options: Let heaven and earth bear witness to my vow.
...Something feels wrong.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Heh heh... anything else?

options: Let the sun and moon witness my heart.
...Something feels wrong.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hee hee, I like that one. Care to say more?
Words fail you. The flower spirit shifts her position in the tree, seemingly drawing closer to you.

When did Yugu's voice fade away? When did the flower fragrance become so overwhelming? How long have you been here? The bustling streets outside have long since fallen silent—now, all you can hear is the voice of "Yingying."
The bashfulness on her face has long vanished. She observes you with a radiant grin, her eyes gleaming with an unsettling shrewdness.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Why did you stop? Keep going! They were so sweet—I'm eager to hear more.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I've never seen true romance in action. Why don't you show me how it's done!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I... Ugh!

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: Stop wasting time and be honest

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm here for one reason only: this fete has trapped my friends and countless innocent people in DisCity, draining their energy and harming them all. I must put an end to this.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The taleteller said... No—you said this was your fete, and that you wanted to invite guests here. Well, here I am.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...So everything you've done, all this effort to come see me—it was all just to ask me to end this fete...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I thought... you truly had some feelings for me...

options: I'm sorry, but please let everyone go.
...Just kidding. Didn't mean it.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: My, how serious you are. And here I thought we'd have a bit more fun together. I see those people out there matter more to you after all.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You came so well-prepared... Why the sudden change of heart? Why aren't you following the script anymore?

She sighs, and only then do you realize Yugu's voice has long since faded away. A rush of floral scent envelops you, muffling the noises from the street. At that moment, you find that all traces of shyness have disappeared from the flower spirit's face.
She observes you with a radiant grin, her eyes gleaming with an unsettling shrewdness.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Don't tell me you—ugh!

steps.speaker: Jump
steps.content: ...Just kidding. Didn't mean it.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Well then, what exactly do you mean?
Redirect to: ["I just wanted to see you so bad."|Stop wasting time and be honest]
Before you can finish speaking, vines suddenly coil around your waist and yank you toward the tree. Flower petals shower your face, blinding you.
With no time to struggle free, something reaches for your chest.

options: Wait!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Nope~
The flower spirit extends her hand towards your chest, skillfully sliding it under your robe, and in one swift motion, plucks out the hidden Chronicles of Romance and Lust.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So this is why you've been acting so strange today, all shy and stumbling over your words? And you even brought a cheat sheet? Let me see...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Huh, all these weird characters... It's written in a language called Disian? Guess I'll borrow your eyes for it.
Vines coil around your eyes, plunging you into darkness. You can only listen as she begins to read in an exaggerated voice.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: "No creature in all creation can elude the clutches of love. One must heed the heart's yearning to capture another's affection. And for those less endowed with innate gifts, three mystical artifacts of romance must be utilized..."

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: "Dazzle them with fine garments, sway them with wealth, and whisper honeyed words of affection. Their heart shall surely bloom with joy, and victory in love shall naturally follow..."

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hahaha, another one of those cliche "beauty and the lord" tales? That girl hasn't made any progress in all these years, such dopey romances! She'd be better off sticking to her ghost stories instead.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And to think she'd set her sights on such an innocent young lord—
steps.female_content: And to think she'd set her sights on such an innocent young lady—

steps.content: The vines release your eyes, and you find her already leaning in close, reaching toward you with a mischievous glint in her eyes. You instantly recall the terrifying scene from yesterday when she had you pinned to the bed.

options: Let go of me!

steps.content: The red glow manages to break through the vines holding you, freeing one of your hands.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not here to play your games! End this demonic fete and release everyone! Our combat units outside have had you surrounded already—you can't hold those hostages forever!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Those people are not food for you to feed on!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh my, so I'm such an evil and terrifying fiend! No wonder you're so angry—you must absolutely despise me, right?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Then why did you come wooing me? Don't tell me you actually believed in those silly dating artifacts—thinking you could win over any villain or foe's heart just like that?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Uh...
She leans in closer, delighting in your flushed face.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hmm... Well then, let me see if it works on such a righteous soul like you...
As she speaks, wisteria vines suddenly spring from behind her, binding your hands. With a laugh, she pulls you down into a rain of falling wisteria blossoms.
[CG: Chief on top of Yingying]
Above you, cascading vines of wisteria drape like a fragrant purple waterfall, its petals drifting down to form a delicate carpet below.

You are now so near that you can discern her long eyelashes casting soft grey shadows on her face. Her hand approaches, yet instead of touching you, she delicately strokes the fine fabric of your attire.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Do you know? True beauty never requires fine silks or precious fabrics. Once she finds someone who truly loves her, in her eyes, you become the most beautiful being in the entire world.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If I had to say what your beauty lacks right now... maybe just a hint of red would do the trick.
She touches her own lips, her fingertip stained with rouge, then gently presses it to your lips. As she softly traces them, you feel a faint moisture.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Mmm... perfect. Your lips are rosy, and your cheek has a lovely glow—you look much more lively now. You always come here looking so drained.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't bring me any gifts next time. Even the most precious jewels can't withstand the test of time. The best gift is simply staying with someone you care about, like now—how we share these moments of blossoms and moonlight together.
Her jade-white arms encircle your neck as she plucks a small flower from behind you, gently tucking it into your hair. Then, she gazes deep into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: How strange... We've only met twice, separated by countless miles and who knows how many years. Once we leave this fete, we might not even speak the same language... Yet I keep dreaming of you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: On this never-ending winter night, you showed up, bringing warmth and light, letting me bloom once again in the cold darkness. These wisteria blossoms all around us—they must be the joy in my heart when I think of you.
She gently caresses your face with the lightest touch, as if knowing how cold her hands are. Each careful movement treats you like an invaluable treasure.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: This joy... it almost frightens me. Like all dreams, this one must end, and you'll eventually return to your world. When that time comes, I'll be even lonelier than before...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I won't ask you to stay—I know that's too much to hope for... I only wish this dream could last a little longer, that you could stay with me a while more, that the day of waking up would take its time to come...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: While you're here with me, I wish you could smile more often...
As she stares at you intently, wisteria shadows sway around, saturating the air with their fragrance. The flower spirit wears a smile, yet her eyes harbor endless unspoken sorrow.
Before you can process her expression, she breaks into an impish laugh.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: How was it? My performance just now wasn't any less impressive than Yugu's, was it?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hmph, I may spend all day sleeping, but I'm from the Wisteria Pavilion! I've learned plenty about romance from my moms—I could craft a love story too!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since you're not enjoying Yugu's script, why not quit playing along with her? Let me handle the rest of the tale instead!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Shall we end the fete? Weave a romantic tale? Or maybe teach that taleteller a lesson? You name it! I'll take volumes three through eight and rewrite them to your taste—all I need is a bit of your Qi in return!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: This is my fete, and what unfolds is our story. The pen should be in our hands, don't you agree?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: My little lord... of DisCity?
